echo_sets.name: Shadow of Shattered Dreams (1-pc) + Rite of Gilded Revelation (2-pc) + Reel of Spliced Memories (2-pc)
echo_sets.note: Collab-exclusive triple-sonata setup. The 1-pc Shadow of Shattered Dreams boosts Heavy Attack DMG while Hack-Shifting is applied, and Adam Smasher's unique Echo Skill (Crit Rate, variable time-stop hold) is tailor-made for her. The 2-pc pieces can be swapped for any Spectro DMG +10% set (Celestial Light, Eternal Radiance, Pact of Neonlight Leap) or ATK% (Lingering Tunes).

echo_sets.name: Celestial Light
echo_sets.note: Large stack of Spectro DMG buffs for Lucy; Mourning Aix adds Spectro and Liberation DMG and is a strong early-game main Echo.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Spectral Trigger + the collab triple-sonata setup (1-pc Shadow of Shattered Dreams, 2-pc Rite of Gilded Revelation, 2-pc Reel of Spliced Memories) in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Reminiscence: Nightmare Adam Smasher in the main slot. Run a Crit 4-cost, two Spectro DMG 3-costs, two ATK% 1-costs, and get ~120% Energy Regen so Liberation is ready each rotation.

ranked_weapons.name: Spectral Trigger
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. Crit DMG main stat, ATK% and Spectro DMG buffs, plus Heavy Attack DMG that ignores 10% enemy DEF under Hack-Shifting. Best in slot by a wide margin.

ranked_weapons.name: Phasic Homogenizer
ranked_weapons.note: Standard-banner Crit DMG pistol; unconditional 12% ATK and 20% All-Attribute DMG when a teammate triggers Tune Break. Best non-signature option.

ranked_weapons.name: Lux & Umbra
ranked_weapons.note: High base ATK and Crit DMG; ATK passive plus Heavy Attack DMG amplification on Echo Skill and 8% DEF ignore.

ranked_weapons.name: Solar Flame
ranked_weapons.note: Best 4-star option, but battlepass-locked; Crit Rate substat with accessible ATK and Heavy Attack DMG buffs.

ranked_weapons.name: Novaburst
ranked_weapons.note: Accessible ATK% 4-star; easy 12% ATK buff on dash or dodge.

stat_priorities.note: Crit piece to balance her Crit ratio; Beebom slightly prefers Crit Rate, Game8 treats them as interchangeable.
ATK% on both 1-costs; her kit scales off ATK.

profile.role_note: Heavy Attack / Hack-Shifting burst DPS; her Liberation freezes enemies in time while she picks damage and debuff programs.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: She was worth pulling during version 3.4 — a strong, fun Spectro main DPS whose best partner Rebecca was free — but as a limited Cyberpunk: Edgerunners collab unit she can no longer be obtained, and Game8 flags that collab banners may never rerun. If she ever returns: a solid pick if you have Rebecca, but meta-wise her damage ceiling trails newer 3.x DPS units, so pure meta accounts can skip.

members.name: Lucy
members.note: Heavy Attack / Hack-Shifting burst DPS; empowered by Rebecca's Outro and her own debuff-stacking Liberation.

members.name: Rebecca
members.note: Lucy's best partner; grants All DMG and Heavy Attack DMG Amplification via Outro, and her turret gets upgraded when paired with Lucy.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Healer plus Off-Tune buildup engine; her field accelerates Tune Break so Hack-Shifting triggers far more often. Shorekeeper or Verina can replace her.

teams.name: Hack-Shifting Team: Lucy + Rebecca + Mornye
teams.rotation: Mornye deploys her field to raise Off-Tune buildup rate, Rebecca sets up her turret and Outro-swaps to hand Lucy All DMG and Heavy Attack DMG Amplification, then Lucy ramps TCP into her enhanced Skill 'Deadlock', builds full Root Access with a Basic Attack chain, casts Dual Threading into Multi-threading, and finishes with her program-select Liberation before swapping out.

members.name: Lucy
members.note: Takes an extended on-field window; ramp TCP to Deadlock, fill Root Access, then fire the full Forte Heavy Attack plus Liberation.

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Heavy Attack buffer and healer; builds Wan Light stacks for the main DPS.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Heals and hands out broad Crit and damage buffs; detonates Stellarealm with her enhanced Intro.

teams.name: Heavy Attack Team: Lucy + Iuno + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens to deploy Stellarealm, Iuno runs her rotation to hand off buffs, then Lucy takes an extended field window: cast skills to ramp TCP into Deadlock, build full Root Access, and fire the full Forte Heavy Attack plus Liberation.

tier_badge.label: Strong DPS
tier_badge.note: Game8 rates her S as a Main DPS / Tower of Adversity unit and Beebom's October 2026 tier list places her in S, citing high front-loaded damage gated by team options tied to Rebecca. MMO Culture's 3.6 list instead ranks her in A, noting a damage ceiling below newer 3.x DPS; tier is therefore marked uncertain.

sequences.verdict: S0R1 is enough for all content. S2 is the standout breakpoint - RAM 32 and a far stronger Multi-threading. S6 only for whales.

pull_path.why: Full hacking loop: TCP, Algorithm Compaction, Netrunner all work at S0.
Starting RAM 32 during Liberations; Pulse Interference adds a 450% ATK hit and full Spoofing Programs; Multi-threading SQL boost rises to 560%.
+40% Heavy Attack and +60% Hack DMG taken by Hacked targets; longer Data Crash stagnation.

nodes.name: The Moon, a Ticket, and a Dream
nodes.effect: Interruption immunity during Payload, Pulse Interference, Dual Threading, Multi-threading; Intro grants +20% ATK for 14s; Quick Action shares recorded Spoofing Programs on kills.

nodes.name: The Blackwall, the Past, the Escape
nodes.effect: Starting RAM 32 on Netrunner/Old Net Deep Dive; Pulse Interference deals +450% ATK Spectro DMG and applies Spoofing Programs; Multi-threading SQL boost rises to 560%.

nodes.name: Cyberpunk
nodes.effect: Override DMG multiplier +50% with +100% Crit DMG; Cripple Movement and Hack Response - Data Crash multipliers +65%.

nodes.name: No Living Legends in Night City
nodes.effect: Team inflicting Hack-Shifting grants the team 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 20s.

nodes.name: A Broken Path to Hell
nodes.effect: Optical Illusion stack limit 2; below 50% HP, gain Optical Illusion on hit (180s CD), triggering a 150% ATK shield.

nodes.name: I Really Want to Stay At Your House
nodes.effect: Targets with Hack-Shifting/Interfered take 40% more Heavy Attack DMG and 60% more Hack DMG from Lucy; Data Crash stagnation lasts 1.5s.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Signature Spectral Trigger before S1 - S0 plus signature covers all content; S2 is the first dupe worth chasing.
